name: Clicking the Groups navigation surfaces all twelve groups A through L
description: When a visitor clicks the Groups link in the navigation, they arrive at a page that surfaces all twelve groups labeled A through L — proving the full group draw is reachable from one click, not split across many pages.

planSteps.description: Click the Groups link in the navigation
Scroll through the destination page to surface all group sections
Verify the destination URL differs from the homepage URL

Verify the page surfaces twelve distinct group sections — counting any group labels that match patterns like A/B/.../L, 'Group A'/'Group B'/.../'Group L', 'GROUP A'/.../'GROUP L', or 'Pool A'/.../'Pool L'
